rules.reason: These refuse instead of wrapping around when two file-declared 64-bit values are combined. rules.reason: The minimal curve.h slice the CNB curve codec needs: cna_cnb_encode_curve takes a native Curve handle and cna_cnb_decode_curve produces one, so the codec is unreachable from a managed-only Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Curve. rules.reason: The minimal content.h slice the CNB loader registry needs: cna_cnb_loader_invoke takes a content manager and refuses without one, measured rather than assumed, so a registered loader could otherwise be resolved and never run. rules.boundReason: imported: cna.extensions.content.NativeContentManager is the collaborator CNA's loader signature demands
